text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And they round the final corner! A fierce 
clash! A heated battle! But—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is this the end for Twin Turbo? Is this 
where her race is run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, it seemed like it was all 
over. But Twin Turbo—!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Like hell this is where it ends~~~! Let's 
GOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh~? My breathin' is... my legs are... 
nooo...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was over, after all. Having burned 
through everything she had, Twin Turbo was 
swallowed up by the pack.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so frustrated, frustrated, frustrated 
frustrated frustrated~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo's so frustrated! I wanna do 
it over from the start. No no nooo!
choice_data_list: One more time is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way she can do it. Twin Turbo 
must know that too. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was probably so frustrated she 
couldn't keep it to herself. 
Unfortunately, she wasn't able to claim 
victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Twin Turbo! You did great!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm always having a blast! 
Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo lost, but they're still 
praising me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is a sport. Naturally, 
everyone aims for victory. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are things that cannot be expressed 
through victory or defeat alone. Things 
that are just as important.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Strength and emotional resonance don't 
always equate. Indeed, if one were to 
describe Twin Turbo..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“—The inequality of emotion. I suppose 
she's an Umamusume whose emotional 
response is always greater.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's always picking a one-on-one 
fight with herself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That is why it stirs the heart. I'd like 
the other girls to follow her example."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both the sharp-witted Biwa Hayahide and 
the dependable, big-sisterly Hishi Amazon 
praised the valiant effort in their own 
words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the Umamusume and fans alike, 
everyone understood it. The charm and 
sheer brilliance of Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo can burn way, way hotter 
than that! That wasn't even close to all 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna wiiin! I'll beat 
Teio! I'll beat everyone else too! And 
then, and then!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just wiiiiin!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo burns bright. Just like that 
setting sun, going full throttle forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He may have only played a supporting role 
in this year's Arima Kinen. But he will 
surely continue walking his own path to 
the fullest, thrilling his fans along the 
way.
